description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring our team is highly skilled and our environment is safe for all residents.

As the SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing educational programs for staff, maintaining compliance with infection control protocols, and conducting surveillance activities. Your expertise will directly contribute to the quality of care and overall well-being of our residents and staff. This position offers a competitive hourly rate.

Join a facility committed to excellence in long-term care, where your contributions are valued and directly impact the health and safety of the community.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist for a PRN (as-needed) opportunity in Inverness, FL. This role offers the flexibility to work on a per diem basis, allowing you to balance your professional commitments with your personal life while making a significant impact on patient recovery.

As a Physical Therapist, you will be instrumental in providing high-quality rehabilitation services to patients, helping them regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will work within a supportive environment, utilizing your expertise to develop and implement individualized treatment plans.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Physical Therapist looking for flexible hours in a rewarding setting. Join a team committed to patient-centered care and professional excellence.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Ability to work independently and manage a flexible schedule
salaryOrBonusInfo: Full-time Physical Therapists, Occupational Therapists, and Speech Therapists are compensated at $39.00 - $40.00 per hour. Compensation for PRN roles will be discussed based on experience.

description: We are urgently seeking dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is a critical opportunity to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being within a supportive and dynamic environment.As a COTA, you will play a vital role in implementing individualized treatment plans under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. Your expertise will contribute directly to the success of our rehabilitation programs, fostering a positive and healing atmosphere for all residents.This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate, commensurate with your experience. If you are a compassionate and skilled COTA looking for a rewarding career opportunity, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Occupational Therapy Assistant program
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00 based on experience.
